id: title:jurajmajerik:lock labels before versions in all prompt reference paths

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces transaction deadlock risk between LLMPromptLabel and LLMPrompt rows during prompt archival, potentially improving reliability of the warehouse ingestion or warehouse-query-dependent workflows.
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate a bounded, substantive change to database transaction locking behavior. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 establish a consistent shared+exclusive lock order on LLMPromptLabel, while P1.F2.H1 explicitly acquires locks on both the label and prompt rows. This represents a correctness and reliability improvement by preventing potential deadlocks between label and row
review.uncertainty: The exact production impact depends on the frequency and contention of these specific database paths, which cannot be verified without runtime metrics or historical incident data. The benefit is demonstrated by the implementation of a safer locking strategy, not by observed outcomes.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are from a single chunk and share a consistent, bounded change group. No other PRs are supplied, so no unrelated-PR uncertainty can be flagged. No tier score is assigned; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds a row-selection lock before version-row access in archive_prompt to avoid deadlock with label writes.
